On a Renesas RZ/G3E platform on Linux 6.18, the new rcar-gen4-thermal driver is not probing. dmesg shows:

  rcar-gen4-thermal: probe failed; no compatible TSC found
  rcar-gen4-thermal: probed 0 sensors out of expected 2

The RZ/G3E has 2 TSC instances per SoC. What device-tree compatible string matches the RZ/G3 family binding, and what clocks / power-domain entries must the DT node contain? Which upstream commit added RZ/G3E support, and how do we compare against a known-good RZ/G3S DT as a reference?
